sections.h2: Cotton stalk is 29.74 million tonnes of surplus residue, mostly unused

chart.title: Cotton stalk is one slice of India's 234 million tonnes of surplus residue
chart.source: National residue estimates as cited in the post.

sections.means: Stalk is mostly burnt in the field or discarded, and a small CBG plant costs Rs 300-500 lakh, beyond most single farmers.
sections.todo: Build cluster-level or FPO-backed biogas capacity rather than expecting individual farmers to convert stalk.

sections.means: Cotton fibre quality is unusually sensitive to potassium, which these soils can under-supply even when they look rich.
